artifacts.notes: The archive URL, https://press.vatican.va/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_const_19651118_dei-verbum_en.html, and https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_const_19651118_dei-verbum_en.html returned byte-identical 43095-byte responses with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-23. This artifact owns that one byte identity; the alias routes are not duplicated. The response contains articles 1-26 and consolidated notes but no promulgation or subscription block and no appended Notificatio. Its note to article 15 cites Mit brennender Sorge at AAS 29 (1937), p. 51, while the Latin web and AAS witnesses give p. 151; the discrepancy is preserved rather than harmonized. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

passages.context: The complete English articles 2-4 were inspected together. They present Revelation as God's self-communication through intrinsically connected deeds and words, Christ as mediator and fullness of Revelation, the preparation of the Gospel in salvation history, and the definitive Christian economy in which no new public revelation is expected before Christ's glorious manifestation.

passages.context: The complete English articles 11-12 were inspected together. They join inspiration, divine and true human authorship, and scriptural truth for salvation with interpretation attentive to authorial intention, literary forms, historical and cultural circumstances, the unity of Scripture, living Tradition, the analogy of faith, and the Church's final judgment.
